notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the game was released!

[b]Hentai Killer: Girls & Chess[/b] -  game in which you have to assemble your beautiful team of girls and put them on the battlefield in a strategic  autobattler.

[b]Hentai Killer: Girls & Chess[/b] - the game in which you have to take on the role of the commander and put a formation of your charming soldiers on the battlefield.
Combining different characters and placing them at different distances allows you to hone your strategic combat skills.
